blocks.text: TORONTO— Tyler Herro scored 32 points, Myles Turner fouled out with a season-high 27 and the Milwaukee Bucks snapped a 13-game losing streak by beating the Toronto Raptors 116-111 in the NBA on Monday night. Kyle Kuzma scored 18 points and rookie Brayden Burries added 14 as the Bucks won for the first time since a 110-102 home victory over Indiana on Oct. 26. READ: NBA: Tyler Herro’s 50 points not enough to lift Bucks over 76ers The 13-game skid was the second-longest in franchise history.
